decisions.reason: Coolant pressure booster systems complement the firm's coolant and chip management portfolio, are still on the website, and serve a steady demand from machine tool users.
Coolant cleaning centrifuges are a natural extension of the core filtration business, remain listed, and support the firm's offer of complete coolant systems.
Scraper belt chip conveyors are a standard, high-volume product for machine tools and fit the firm's established conveyor business.
Hinged belt chip conveyors are core standard equipment for chip handling and remain on the website, so dropping them would weaken the product range.
